paragraphs: Rav Huna bar Minyomi, in Rav Yosef’s time. He bought tekhelet from the people of Rav Amram the Pious’s house and came before Rav Yosef …. Chanan the tailor met him and said, “Poor Yosef …; I bought tekhelet from the people of the house of Rabbana, Rabbi Chiyya bar Abba’s brother, and came before Rav Mattanah and Rav Yehudah of Hagronya”: Avodah Zarah 39a. Perhaps Rav Acha and Rav Chanina bar Minyomi were his brothers.
